item.title: Fire Apparatus Struck Responding to Fire That Displaced 18 People in NJ
item.description: A Newark fire truck was disabled after being struck by a car while responding to a two-alarm fire that displaced 18 people. The cause of the fire is under investigation. The post Fire Apparatus Struck Responding to Fire That Displaced 18 People in NJ appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: MA FD Receives Safety Equipment Grant
item.description: The Amesbury Fire Department received a $24,060 grant from the Last Call Foundation to purchase 40 personal safety rope systems, addressing a significant equipment gap for firefighter safety. The post MA FD Receives Safety Equipment Grant appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: FL Fire Departments Awarded $1.6M in State Grants

item.title: Council Struggles with Vote But Approves Rezoning for VFD

item.title: Destin (FL) Unveils New 52-Foot Floating Emergency Room
item.description: A new 52-foot rescue vessel, Marine 19, was unveiled in Destin, Florida, enhancing emergency care on water by allowing trauma teams to stabilize patients before reaching shore, especially during peak tourist seasons. item.title: What’s New in Attack and Supply Lines
item.description: Hoselines are firefighters’ lifelines, used not only to fight fires but to also lead them out of danger in an emergency. Keeping those aims in mind, hose manufacturers have continued to improve their hoseline products in terms of performance, durability, and handling. item.title: MO Firefighter Killed in Apparatus Crash While Responding to Grass Fire
item.description: A Missouri firefighter, Jackson Warren, 27, died in a rollover crash while responding to a grass fire. Another firefighter was injured.
